name: kairo-engine-monorepo
description: Modern, Modular, High-Performance 2D/3D TypeScript Game Engine & Web-Based Editor

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp -r examples/go-wasm/*.wasm examples/go-wasm/*.js dist/examples/go-wasm/ && cp -r examples/go-runner/*.wasm examples/go-runner/*.js dist/examples/go-runner/
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/ai.test.js tests/ecs.test.js tests/math.test.js tests/physics.test.js

author: Kairo Engine Team
